title: A Delaware judge reassigns Elon Musk cases over "disproportionate media attention" after allegations she "liked" a LinkedIn post celebrating a Musk legal defeat (Sujeet Indap/Financial Times)
summary: Sujeet Indap / Financial Times: A Delaware judge reassigns Elon Musk cases over “disproportionate media attention” after allegations she “liked” a LinkedIn post celebrating a Musk legal defeat — Chancellor Kathaleen McCormick denies bias but cites media glare as risk to justice
contentText:
Sujeet Indap / Financial Times :

A Delaware judge reassigns Elon Musk cases over “disproportionate media attention” after allegations she “liked” a LinkedIn post celebrating a Musk legal defeat   —  Chancellor Kathaleen McCormick denies bias but cites media glare as risk to justice
